policy_basis: Google Play User Data and Data safety requirements; final declaration must match the exact release artifact and integrated SDKs

production_purchase_verification.recommended_architecture: server-side purchase-token verification before authoritative entitlement grant

data_safety_candidate.reason: 12.4 production billing integration is not yet frozen; the final form must cover the exact release artifact and all SDK/backend behavior
data_safety_candidate.payment_service_financial_data: Google Play may collect payment information directly under its own terms; the app must not claim developer collection when the app never accesses that payment information
data_safety_candidate.purchase_history_or_purchase_token: reassess and declare as applicable after 12.4

must_cover: data accessed, collected, used and shared

release_requirements: complete 12.4 billing integration and repeat technical data-flow audit
inspect final Android manifest and merged permissions from the release AAB
inventory every third-party SDK in the final artifact
publish privacy policy on a stable public URL and expose the final version in-app
finalize product/legal_documents.json from pre_release to final and synchronize its public URLs
complete Play Console Data safety form from the frozen release behavior
ensure store declaration, runtime legal surface and privacy policy remain consistent
pass legal_surface_gate.py --release in addition to privacy_data_safety_gate.py --release
record final Data Safety answers in this repository
